moves.name: Fake Out
moves.description:
Normal (Physical)
Base Power: 40
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 3
Has a 100% chance to make the target flinch. Fails unless it is the user's first turn on the field.

moves.name: Parting Shot
moves.description:
Dark (Status)
Base Power: N/A
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 0
Lowers the target's Attack and Special Attack by 1 stage. If this move is successful, the user switches out even if it is trapped and is replaced immediately by a selected party member. The user does not switch out if the target's Attack and Special Attack stat stages were both unchanged, or if there are no unfainted party members.

moves.name: Flare Blitz
moves.description:
Fire (Physical)
Base Power: 120
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 0
Has a 10% chance to burn the target. If the target lost HP, the user takes recoil damage equal to 33% the HP lost by the target, rounded half up, but not less than 1 HP.

moves.name: Throat Chop
moves.description:
Dark (Physical)
Base Power: 80
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 0
For 2 turns, the target cannot use sound-based moves.

moves.name: Darkest Lariat
moves.description:
Dark (Physical)
Base Power: 85
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 0
Ignores the target's stat stage changes, including evasiveness.

moves.name: Protect
moves.description:
Normal (Status)
Base Power: N/A
Accuracy: N/A
Priority: 4
The user is protected from most attacks made by other Pokemon during this turn. This move has a 1/X chance of being successful, where X starts at 1 and triples each time this move is successfully used. X resets to 1 if this move fails, if the user's last move used is not Baneful Bunker, Burning Bulwark, Detect, Endure, King's Shield, Max Guard, Obstruct, Protect, Quick Guard, Silk Trap, Spiky Shield, or Wide Guard, or if it was one of those moves and the user's protection was broken. Fails if the user moves last this turn.

moves.name: Helping Hand
moves.description:
Normal (Status)
Base Power: N/A
Accuracy: N/A
Priority: 5
The power of the target's attack this turn is multiplied by 1.5 (this effect is stackable). Fails if there is no ally adjacent to the user or if the ally already moved this turn, but does not fail if the ally is using a two-turn move.

moves.name: Close Combat
moves.description:
Fighting (Physical)
Base Power: 120
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 0
Lowers the user's Defense and Special Defense by 1 stage.

moves.name: Taunt
moves.description:
Dark (Status)
Base Power: N/A
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 0
Prevents the target from using non-damaging moves for its next three turns. Pokemon with the Oblivious Ability or protected by the Aroma Veil Ability are immune.

moves.name: Will-O-Wisp
moves.description:
Fire (Status)
Base Power: N/A
Accuracy: 85
Priority: 0
Burns the target.

items.name: Sitrus Berry
items.description: Restores 1/4 max HP when at 1/2 max HP or less. Single use.

items.name: Passho Berry
items.description: Halves damage taken from a supereffective Water-type attack. Single use.

items.name: Chople Berry
items.description: Halves damage taken from a supereffective Fighting-type attack. Single use.

items.name: Leftovers
items.description: At the end of every turn, holder restores 1/16 of its max HP.

items.name: Shuca Berry
items.description: Halves damage taken from a supereffective Ground-type attack. Single use.

items.name: White Herb
items.description: Restores all lowered stat stages to 0 when one is less than 0. Single use.

items.name: Life Orb
items.description: Holder's attacks do 1.3x damage, and it loses 1/10 its max HP after the attack.

items.name: Expert Belt
items.description: Holder's attacks that are super effective against the target do 1.2x damage.

items.name: Bright Powder
items.description: The accuracy of attacks against the holder is 0.9x.

abilities.name: Intimidate
abilities.description: On switch-in, this Pokemon lowers the Attack of opposing Pokemon by 1 stage. Pokemon with the Inner Focus, Oblivious, Own Tempo, or Scrappy Abilities and Pokemon behind a substitute are immune.

abilities.name: Blaze
abilities.description: When this Pokemon has 1/3 or less of its maximum HP, rounded down, its offensive stat is multiplied by 1.5 while using a Fire-type attack.
